name: twopaper
description: One-stop academic literature tools for agents: aggregate search, unified PDF download, full-text PDF→Markdown via MinerU, and source-attributed analysis across 13+ platforms (arXiv, PubMed, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, Scopus, Springer, WoS, etc.) with scansci bridging for paywalled papers.

wos_api_key.title: Web of Science API Key
wos_api_key.description: Clarivate Web of Science 检索（引文分析、高被引）。申请：https://developer.clarivate.com/apis

elsevier_api_key.title: Elsevier API Key
elsevier_api_key.description: Scopus 检索 + ScienceDirect（ScienceDirect 另需产品授权）。申请：https://dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage

wiley_tdm_token.title: Wiley TDM Token
wiley_tdm_token.description: Wiley 文本挖掘全文下载（需机构订阅注册）。申请：https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/library-info/resources/text-and-datamining

mineru_token.title: MinerU Token
mineru_token.description: get_fulltext 的 PDF→Markdown 转换（Precise API）。申请：https://mineru.net/apiManage

oa_email.title: OA Contact Email
oa_email.description: Unpaywall / Europe PMC 合法 OA 定位的礼貌池邮箱，填你自己的邮箱即可，无需申请。

pubmed_api_key.title: PubMed API Key (可选)
pubmed_api_key.description: 把 PubMed 限流从 3 rps 提到 10 rps。申请：https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK25497/

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API Key (可选)
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: 把 Semantic Scholar 限流从 20 rpm 提到 ~180 rpm。申请：https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API Key (可选)
openalex_api_key.description: OpenAlex key+credits 模式（无 key 也可用）。申请：https://openalex.org/
